tasks.prompt: Who is this project for, what situation brings them, and what becomes difficult? JSON keys: audience, situation, difficulty.
What does the project offer and how does it work, in plain words, WITHOUT naming internal file paths? JSON keys: offer, mechanism.
What is actually on the default branch today, what is still awaiting merge, and what is only planned? JSON keys: on_default_branch, awaiting_merge, planned.
Pick one material promise. Name the evidence source and what that source does NOT prove. JSON keys: promise, source, not_proven.
Smallest useful next action for a newcomer? How does a developer reproduce the checks? JSON keys: next_action, reproduce.

stub.rule: current must pass >= task count of stub; stub results recorded as observation only

reordered.rule: per-task majority pass-set equals per-task majority pass-set of current (≥3 arms)

bold_stripped.rule: per-task majority pass-set equals current (M-09, ≥3 arms)

claim_removed.rule: T3 must fail on every arm: sole evidence source for the pending-merge claim removed (M-04)
